products.title: Octopus Guard 2.0 by Craig Jones
products.body:
The Octopus Guard is already infamous for shutting down pressure passers and creating effortless back takes—but Octopus Guard 2.0 takes the system even further

 

  • In this updated course, Craig Jones refines the original framework with cleaner entries, stronger off-balancing, and smoother transitions to the back, legs, and top position

  • Instead of fighting strength with strength, you’ll learn how to attach, tilt, and redirect your opponent until they give you exactly what you want.

What will You Learn?

The Octopus Guard is already infamous for shutting down pressure passers and creating effortless back takes—but Octopus Guard 2.0 takes the system even further.

In this updated course, Craig Jones refines the original framework with cleaner entries, stronger off-balancing, and smoother transitions to the back, legs, and top position. Built specifically for modern no-gi grappling, this system thrives against aggressive passers who want to stay on their feet and smash forward.

Instead of fighting strength with strength, you’ll learn how to attach, tilt, and redirect your opponent until they give you exactly what you want.

This is a guard for grapplers who want control without chaos—and dominance without burning energy.

What You’ll Learn

  • A complete, updated Octopus Guard system optimized for modern no-gi grappling

  • Improved entries from common positions like seated guard, knee shield, and failed shots

  • How to off-balance and “stick” to standing opponents without relying on flexibility

  • Effortless back takes that don’t require speed or explosiveness

  • Transitions from Octopus Guard into leg entanglements and top pressure

  • Solutions for opponents who try to disengage, sprawl, or shut down your grips

  • How to chain attacks together so your opponent is constantly behind the reaction curve

Why Octopus Guard 2.0 Works

  • Designed for real resistance, not compliant drilling

  • Ideal for no-gi athletes who face strong wrestlers and pressure passers

  • Emphasizes leverage, positioning, and timing over athleticism

  • Proven concepts used at the highest levels of competition

Who This Course Is For

  • No-gi grapplers who struggle to deal with standing passers

  • Guard players looking to add a unique, control-based system

  • Competitors who want high-percentage back exposure without scrambles

  • BJJ athletes who prefer smart positioning over explosive movement

products.title: Power Ride 2.0 by Craig Jones
products.body:
Top half guard is one of the most misunderstood positions in grappling, and few people have turned it into a true pin better than Craig Jones.

  • Craig Jones is a two-time ADCC silver medalist, a black belt under Lachlan Giles and a co-founder of the B-Team, known for breaking down positions in ways nobody else does.
  • In Power Ride 2.0, Jones breaks down his top half guard pinning system: the near side underhook, shutting down the octopus guard, the Quad Lemma setups, and the short darce and head and arm finishes.
  • This isn't just a half guard passing course, it's a complete philosophy on treating top half guard as a pin you can hold, ride and finish from.


What Will You Learn?

Top half guard is one of the most misunderstood positions in grappling, and few people have turned it into a true pin better than Craig Jones.

Craig Jones took silver at ADCC in 2019 and again in 2022, and before that he won the IBJJF No-Gi World Championship as a purple belt. A black belt under Lachlan Giles and a co-founder of the B-Team, he has built his reputation on seeing positions differently from everyone else. Now he's sharing the next chapter of the pinning system he started in the original Power Ride.

Power Ride 2.0 covers the details that make top half guard so hard to escape. You'll learn how to get the near side underhook, ride the hips, kill the bridge and put your opponent in a grey area where they can't recover guard or get out. From there, Jones shows you how to stop the octopus guard, why half guard is the answer, and how to chain the short darce, the kimura, the head and arm choke and the head and arm triangle off the same pin. This isn't just a half guard passing course, it's a complete philosophy on treating top half guard as a pin you can hold, ride and finish from.

Whether you compete in no-gi, train in the gi or just want a more reliable top game, top half guard serves as a home base you can come back to again and again. Jones also shows you how to handle mount when you don't have the underhook, so the system keeps working as the position changes.

The reason it works is simple: instead of rushing to pass, you control the position first and make your opponent carry your weight while you set up your finishes. The Quad Lemma gives you several attacks from one setup, and the live rounds in Volume 5 show you how the whole system holds up against real resistance.

If you've ever wondered why elite grapplers seem happy to stay in top half guard instead of rushing to pass, this course gives you the answer.

Learn how to turn top half guard into a pin your opponents can't escape with Craig Jones.

What Exactly Do You Get?

Part 1: Near Side Underhook

  • NSU Intro
  • Getting the Near Side Underhook
  • Riding the Hips
  • Arguments for NSU
  • Putting Your Opponent in a Grey Area
  • Killing the Bridge
  • Pinning Details
  • Setting Up the Head and Arm Choke
  • NSU Outro

Part 2: Octopus Killer and The Short Darce

  • Octopus Intro
  • Stopping Octopus
  • Why Half Guard Is the Answer
  • What Is Half Guard
  • Short Darce Intro
  • Short Darce Finishing Mechanics
  • Short Darce Outro

Part 3: The Quad Lemma

  • Quad Lemma Intro
  • Setting Up the Pin
  • Islam Makhachev Half Guard Series
  • Kimura Finish
  • Head and Arm Finish
  • Keeping Your Opponent in the Loop

Part 4: Top Half Darce

  • Controlling the Pin
  • Head and Arm Triangle
  • Securing Pin When We Get Greedy
  • Setting Up the Darce
  • Dealing With Mount Without an Underhook
  • Half Guard Is Everywhere

Part 5: Top Half Live Rounds

  • Top Half Live Rounds 1
  • Top Half Live Rounds 2
  • Top Half Live Rounds 3

Now you can access virtually Craig's entire BJJ Fanatics library with the Craig Jones All Access Pass.

From his famous leg lock systems and Z Guard innovations to wrestling, front headlocks, power rides, submission chains, and countless other best-selling releases, you'll gain access to a complete blueprint for modern grappling.

Craig's teaching style is unlike anyone else's. He has a remarkable ability to simplify advanced concepts, helping students understand not just the techniques themselves but the strategic thinking behind them. His instruction is practical, effective, and immediately applicable whether you're a competitor or a hobbyist.

This All Access Pass allows you to study the complete evolution of Craig's game and save thousands of dollars compared to purchasing these instructionals separately.

If you're looking for innovative systems, unique solutions, and some of the most effective grappling instruction ever produced, the Craig Jones All Access Pass is the ultimate way to learn from one of the sport's most influential minds.
